resources.string: A talking clock for current Android versions.
This app does not collect, store or share any personal data. Time announcements are generated on the device by the text-to-speech engine you have installed.
This software is provided without any warranty. In no event shall the authors be liable for any damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, this software.
This device has no proximity sensor.
Android sends headset buttons to the app that played audio most recently. While a headset button is enabled here, a paused music player may not receive it.
Shake detection keeps the motion sensor running while the screen is off, which uses more battery.
This settings page is not available on this device.
Show the night clock over the lock screen
Tap to allow full-screen notifications, so that a swipe over the sensor can wake the screen and show the clock.
Tap to allow exact alarms. Without them, Android may delay the interval announcements.
Tap to allow notifications, which show the speaking clock and the night clock and let you stop them.
Tap and set this app to \"Unrestricted\" if announcements are late or missing while the screen is off.
Not restricted. Announcements can run while the screen is off.
